name._comment: end_pointer 0x88 → next section start (minus 4 bytes padding)

head._comment: end_pointer 0x60 → next section start (minus 24 bytes padding)

body._comment: end_pointer 0x64 → next section start (minus 8 bytes padding)

arms._comment: end_pointer 0x68 → next section start (minus 16 bytes padding)

waist._comment: end_pointer 0x6C → next section start (minus 16 bytes padding)

legs._comment: end_pointer 0x70 → next section start (minus 24 bytes padding)

name._comment: end_pointer 0xFC → next section start (minus 12 bytes padding)

description._comment: end_pointer 0x100 → next section start (minus 12 bytes padding)

ranks._comment: Rank requirement label pairs (HR1+, HR1~). Struct: 2 s32p + 12 bytes padding = 20 bytes.

goocoo._comment: Goocoo (グーク) pet: accessories, garden, personality, interactions and food. Header block 0x3D8-0x470; every table is a flat s32p array, names and descriptions row for row. Row 0 of each accessory table is 'remove' (はずす / アクセサリを外します。).

accessory_series._comment: Accessory series names (ギザギザシリーズ, 水玉シリーズ, ...).

name._comment: Accessory slot 1 names: hats, wigs and other headwear.

description._comment: Accessory slot 1 descriptions, row for row with accessory_1/name.

name._comment: Accessory slot 2 names: ponchos, uniforms, overalls and other clothes.

description._comment: Accessory slot 2 descriptions, row for row with accessory_2/name.

name._comment: Accessory slot 3 names: masks, snorkels, bottles.

description._comment: Accessory slot 3 descriptions, row for row with accessory_3/name.
Accessory slot 4 descriptions, row for row with accessory_4/name.

name._comment: Accessory slot 5 names: cacti, snowmen, tail feathers and other props.

description._comment: Accessory slot 5 descriptions, row for row with accessory_5/name.

garden_series._comment: Garden set series names (きほんシリーズ, ミニチュアシリーズ, ...).

name._comment: Garden floor (芝生/床) names, one per garden series.

description._comment: Garden floor descriptions, row for row with garden_floor/name.

name._comment: Garden pond (水場) names, one per garden series.

description._comment: Garden pond descriptions, row for row with garden_pond/name.

name._comment: Garden bed (寝床) names, one per garden series.

description._comment: Garden bed descriptions, row for row with garden_bed/name.

personality._comment: Personality names (のんびり, さみしがり, ...); 3 null slots follow.

interaction_manner._comment: How an interaction is done (心をこめてやさしく, ...), row for row with interaction_action.

interaction_action._comment: Interaction verbs (なでまわす, 話しかける, ...).

food_description._comment: Descriptions of the food given to the Goocoo (こんがり肉, ...).

tips._comment: Tip pages shown as scrolls/boards; flat s32p arrays hung off the dat header, each padded with nulls after the last page.

hunter_basics._comment: '＜ハンターの基本 その１＞' ... : hunter basics, 10 pages.

dojo_rules._comment: '＜狩人道場の掟 その１＞' ... (我輩考案 version), 28 pages.

dojo_rules_instructor._comment: '＜狩人道場の掟 その１＞' ... (教官考案 version), 30 pages.

pac._comment: mhfpac.bin string tables. Skills use pointer-pair mode; text_* tables use null-terminated grouped or count-based strided modes.

name._comment: Skill point names, one per row; slots 225-231 are null padding. end_pointer 0xA1C → next section start

effect._comment: Activated skill names, one per row; slot 535 is null padding. end_pointer 0xBC0 → next section start

effect_z._comment: Zenith skill names: three lists (27, 27 and 53 names) padded with nulls to 32, 32 and 56 slots, one name per row. end_pointer 0xFB0 → next section start

name._comment: Caravan skill (狩人珠スキル) names. 112 slots before the description table at 0xACC; the last 3 are null.

description._comment: Caravan skill descriptions, row for row with caravan/name (row 0 is the 'select a skill' prompt).

menu._comment: Town/box UI menu tables in mhfpac.bin, reached via pointer-directory slots 0x2D8-0x908 (previously unmapped). entry_count is capped to the primary run that aligns across Z-era (JP source, client/pc-z-jp) and ZZ-era (EN/FR targets); duplicate/colour-variant and ZZ-only tail entries are intentionally excluded.

item_box._comment: Item/equip box menu: Deposit/Take/Organise/Sell Items, Send to Item Box, Combination (slots 0-5; null at slot 6)

change_equip._comment: Equipment box submenu: Change Equipment, Edit/Equip/Register Set, Town Set Toggle, Colour, Caravan Skills (slots 0-6). SR Settings (slot 13) excluded: Z/ZZ diverge there (Z JP = 秘伝書の装備).

smith._comment: Blacksmith/deco/sigil/cuff menu: Create/Upgrade Weapon/Armour, Create/Insert/Remove/Destroy Deco, armour parts, cuffs, Brand/Remove Sigil (slots 0-21; aligns Z/ZZ)

options._comment: Options menu tabs: title + Display(Town/Gen-Quests/High Grade), Input Options, NPC Settings, Chat, Sound, Post Screenshot, Other (slots 0-10; null at slot 20)

text_48._comment: Skill tree / decoration name pairs: fixed 423 entries, 2 s32p each (8 bytes per entry).

inf._comment: Quest data (mhfinf.bin). Multi-level category table with 8 text strings per quest.

nav._comment: Hunter Navi data (mhfnav.bin). Text fields not yet documented in ImHex patterns.

gao._comment: Felyne partner / companion data (mhfgao.bin). First-pass coverage: header-rooted null-terminated s32p tables. Additional sections (0x020/0x028/0x02C equipment description tables, 0x040 event dialogue) are reached via meta-tables at 0xC640-0xC680 and still need struct RE.

armor_helm._comment: Felyne head armor names (ネコヘルム). Uses fixed count because a 'YYYY/MM/DD' build-date ASCII string is stored between the table end and its 0 terminator, which would break null-terminated mode.

armor_mail._comment: Felyne body armor names (ネコメイル).

weapon_names._comment: Felyne weapon names. 257 fixed entries. First three are English fallbacks ('None', 'Cat Bone Pick', 'Cat Paw Punch') pointing into the English text region at 0x34000+.

armor_desc._comment: Felyne armor descriptions. Flat s32p array, 3 strings per description followed by a 0 terminator (4 ptrs per group). Row 0 is an English 'Nothing equipped.' fallback with only 1 non-null ptr.

weapon_desc._comment: Felyne weapon descriptions. Same layout as armor_desc (s32p groups of 4, 3 strings + 0 terminator per description).

dialogue_type_0._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 0 (40 lines, enthusiastic/cat-fighter).

dialogue_type_1._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 1 (40 lines, humble/grateful).

dialogue_type_2._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 2 (40 lines, timid/anxious).

dialogue_type_3._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 3 (40 lines, aloof/self-reliant).

dialogue_type_4._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 4 (40 lines, earnest/trainee).

dialogue_type_5._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 5 (40 lines, polite/respectful).

dialogue_type_6._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 6 (40 lines, cheerful/spirited).

dialogue_type_7._comment: Felyne partner dialogue template, personality type 7 (40 lines, cool/casual).

skill_text._comment: Felyne skill descriptions + English skill names. Flat s32p array of 238 entries at header 0x124 -> 0x13EC0: [0..1] English headers ('None', 'Disables wind pressure.'), [2..55] 54 Japanese skill effect descriptions (the previously orphan region at 0x13EC8 is reachable as entries [2..55] of this table), [56..237] 182 English skill name/description strings. End of array coincides with the start of the other slices at header 0x108/0x10c.

skill_names_zenith._comment: English Zenith/Myriad Felyne skill names (9 entries: Status Immunity, Status Immunity Myriad, No Stamin Depletion [Small/Large], Elemental Attack Up, Affinity Up [Small/Large], Divine Protection, Goddess' Embrace).

sqd._comment: Squad / NPC partner data (mhfsqd.bin). Greenfield RE: the file header at 0x00-0x38 stores 15 u32 pointers that delimit struct-strided tables in the data region, with a flat Shift-JIS string blob at 0x40-0x14C0. String pointers are embedded as fields within structs (not s32p arrays). First-pass coverage: 6 header-rooted struct-strided tables (~190 strings). Tables at 0x00/0x04/0x08/0x0C/0x1C/0x20/0x2C/0x30/0x34/0x38 are non-string / complex and not yet extracted.

npc_names._comment: NPC partner names (Aaron, Bart, Calvin, Tania, ...). 40 entries, stride 8, string ptr at field 0. Ends where star_rank starts (header 0x24 = 0x1B40); the next 3 structs are the star labels.

star_rank._comment: Star rank labels (one/two/three stars). 3 entries, stride 8, field 0. End matches header 0x20 (0x1B58).

skill_activation._comment: Squad skill activation messages ('Skill X activates.'). 35 entries, stride 16, string ptr at field 8. End matches header 0x14 (0x1DC0).

skill_description._comment: Squad skill descriptions. 26 entries, stride 12, string ptr at field 4. End matches header 0x10 (0x1F00).

skill_quest_label._comment: Skill quest-count labels ('Usable 5 times per quest', ...). 80 entries, stride 12, string ptr at field 4. End matches header 0x0C (0x22C0).

header_labels._comment: Header / placeholder labels (point suppression, point reset). 3 entries, stride 12, string ptr at field 4. End matches header 0x34 (0x1510) — but layout is irregular; only field 4 is reliably a string across all rows. First entry is a placeholder '1234567890'.

rcc._comment: Reception / event info strings (mhfrcc.bin). The header pairs each table pointer with its count: 0x00/0x04 = event struct table (events_full), 0x08/0x0C = UI label pointer table (events_en), 0x10/0x14 = a third table (count 0).

events_en._comment: Event screen UI labels (Japanese, despite the name: button hints, 'not available in the beginner district'). s32p table at *0x08, count at 0x0C (8).

events_full._comment: Event info multi-field struct table at 0x5c0 (7 rows x 36-byte stride). Header u32 at 0x00 = 0x5c0 (base), header u32 at 0x04 = 7 (count). Each row carries up to 4 string pointer fields at +0x14 (title), +0x18 (description/alt title), +0x1C / +0x20 (usually '−' placeholders but row 1 stores 'Guild Conquest is underway!' and a '残り時間…' template).

msx._comment: Mezeporta Festa item/effect strings (mhfmsx.bin). First-pass coverage: a 17-entry struct-strided table at literal file offset 0x2abc containing (name_ptr, desc_ptr) pairs per 0x24-byte struct. Most slots are '----' placeholders; ~10 slots contain real item names and their effect descriptions.
